tree.heading: Establishment Authorized.—
tree.text: The Secretary of Defense may establish a School of Nursing.

tree.heading: Degree Granting Authority.—
tree.text: The School of Nursing may include a program that awards a bachelor of science in nursing.

tree.heading: Phased Development.—
tree.text: The Secretary of Defense may develop the School of Nursing in phases as determined appropriate by the Secretary.
